{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')

# Identify QA orders: revenue = 999999.99 (after cleaning)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders identified: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Confirm their revenue strings contain commas
print('\nSample of QA order revenue strings:')
print(qa_orders['revenue'].unique())

# Filter for completed orders and remove QA orders
completed_orders = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute the mean revenue of actual completed orders (excluding QA)
mean_revenue_cleaned = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f'\nMean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue_cleaned}')"}
